_comment: DELIBERATELY EMPTY. No labeling session has been run, and an empty seed is the honest
state — not a placeholder to be filled with plausible-looking rows. Labeling requires a
human pass over real seller review text, which is a separate gated activity: read-only,
nothing copied or committed, only these derived labels leaving the machine.
Until `labels` reaches the adequacy floor in RUBRIC.md (>= 200 labeled, >= 40 NEEDS_LOOK),
ReviewAnalyzerEvalIT refuses to print a verdict and says why. An under-powered seed that
quietly reported a number would be worse than no seed: it would look like evidence.
Each entry carries ONLY a review-id fingerprint and a label. Never the body, the raw
리뷰글번호, the rating, the date, the product, or any seller identity — the harness reads
the rating from the local database at evaluation time. See RUBRIC.md section 3, including
why the fingerprint is leak-hygiene rather than anonymity.
